Nightbringer Yasuo Chroma - White/Grey hair Base form, Grey/Purple during R passive

Purple Hue on abilities

Thanks to static.2 for helping find a work around for a bug, if your FPS is uncapped over 210, the skin will bug out, so if you experience it, you may wanna turn down the FPS! :D

I'm new to modding, this is my first attempt :D I will continue with this mod as a project and eventually add more Cosmetic modding and Animation changes with Voice lines! (at least that's the goal!)

When im ready with an updated version of this mod with animation changes i will make it as a separate mod in case people would rather just use the chroma, thanks! :D
